title: Hydrology
description: Water moves through rock as through a sponge, slowly: Darcy's law, flow = permeability × pressure gradient. Under the plains lie aquifers of rain that fell before the last ice age. Unlocks the Aquifer Pump.

puzzle.goal: Water of viscosity μ seeps through rock of permeability k, across an area A, driven by a pressure difference P over a length L. Write the flow Q.
puzzle.name: Darcy's law
puzzle.ask: Find Q in litres a second for k = @{k} m², A = @{A} m², P = 1e5 Pa, m = @{m} Pa·s (water), L = @{L} m.
puzzle.method: Like current through a resistor: flow grows with the push (the pressure gradient) and the ease of passage (k/μ).
